Name: Alex After Dark - A Tsun-Yandere Dialogue and Event Expansion Pack
Author: loshionbottle
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/xKJhVHX6/overview-better.png[/img]

[font=Trebuchet MS]This mod adds 800+ lines of dialogue for Alex, plus giving him 7 new events & overwriting his vanilla ones! I know this whole series is supposed to be turning all the bachelors into yandere but... I just couldn't see Alex this way, so I turned him Tsundere (with a spark of yandere at the end) instead.[/font]

[b][color=#e06666][font=Trebuchet MS]WARNING: THERE ARE A FEW EVENTS (THE NEW 3 HEART) WHICH COULD POTENTIALLY TRIGGER USERS WITH EPILEPSY[/font][/color][/b]
[b][color=#e06666][font=Trebuchet MS]The lights simply flicker on/off.[/font][/color][/b]

[b][i][color=#e06666][size=4]POTENTIAL TRIGGER WARNINGS[/size][/color]
[/i]There are no smut events in this pack! However, this is supposed to be creepy & you may or may not like what's offered here. Please view the following at your own distretion.

[u]OVERALL
[/u]The figure's NPC is used in a few events. Its presence is supposed to be unsettling. 

[u]SPECIFICALLY[/u]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b] The 3Heart (Hillbilly) and 9Heart (NoKiss) involve the player being choked ONLY if you enable this in the config menu. It is automatically set to no-choking for you sensitive farmers.[/b][/*]
[*][b]The 9Heart (no matter which one) might involve a kiss, might involve his hands on your legs, and might involve him smiling against your lips. It doesn't go farther than that tbh.[/b][/*]
[*][b]The 10Heart involves **LITERARY MENTIONS** of blood, knives, implied murder, drunk men, daddy issues, and prison.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[url=https://ibb.co/6Z7yTqB][/url][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/hxhBXTzw/faq-better.png[/img][/url]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ea9999][i]What portrait mod are you using in the mod photos? [/i][/color]
[/b]I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16838]Rin's Portraits[/url]![/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][i][color=#ea9999]Is this compatible with...?[/color][/i]
[/b]For most dialogue mods it's an iffy thing. If you're placing in a dialogue mod for Sebastian, then yeah this one'll work fine. On the other hand, If you're ﻿placing in a mod for Alex, like some other Alex dialogue mods, then no. HOWEVER, in the config option there are options to turn off the dialogue/events if you prefer someone else's![/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Moreover, these mods are not made with poly in mind, nor will i be offering explicit poly compatibility. nonetheless, they will [b]still work fine with poly mods[/b].  [/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ea9999][i]Can I translate to...?﻿[/i][/color]
[/b]Yes! I give you my full permission to translate to whatever language you're wanting! One major change with this pack is it's setup for i18n! Making your ﻿lives much easier (hopefully). Just be sure to note me as the original author, please![/font]


[url=https://ibb.co/92ppqBy][/url][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Rw6KfsD/requirements-better.png[/img][/url]

[font=Trebuchet MS]As well as [b]Content Patcher[/b] & [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] you need Shadows, Sam, AND Sebastian After Dark.[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Update 2.0.0 now also requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url][/font]


[url=https://ibb.co/4JMC6Lz][/url][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/TxzNZh6p/config-menu-better.png[/img][/url]
[u][b][color=#e06666]PLAYER CONFIGURATION[/color][/b]
[/u][b]  ﻿Player Pronouns: 
  ﻿[color=#e06666]CAUTION - These are DIFFERENT compared to Sam's or Seb's pack[/color]
[/b][color=#e06666]  ﻿If you use She/Her pronouns, PAY ATTENTION to where you're putting things. I did not make an error here.[/color] 
      ﻿﻿There are 3 slots for you to input your pronouns:
﻿  ﻿    ﻿﻿- Player Pronouns 1: [i]Would typically be something similar to "Them", "Her", "Him".
[/i]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 2: [i]Would typically be something similar to "Their", "Her", "His".[/i]
[i]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 3: Would typically be something similar to "They", "She", "He".

[/i][b]Pet Name: 
[/b][i]﻿﻿    Sets a desired name he refers to you as. I've been told users use things like "Angel", "Sunshine", "Babe", etc.[/i]
[b]﻿Descriptive Word:
[/b][i]﻿﻿     Would typically be "Pretty", "Cute", "Handsome", etc.[/i]
[b]Good...:
[/b][i]      ﻿﻿Erm, it's called a PRAISE KINK, tyvm. But, this is typically "Boy", "Girl", [s]"Slut"[/s]
[/i][b]Marriage Affection[/b]
[i]  ﻿  How Sam refers to you after marriage. Would typically be "Husband", "Wife", "Spouse", etc.[/i]

[u][b]EVENTS/DIALOGUE/MAIL CONFIGURATION[/b][/u]
﻿You are able to turn off/on events in general by toggling[b] "All Events, No Jealousy Events, No Events".[/b]
[b][color=#e06666]**NEW** You are able to turn off/on CHOKING events by toggling "I'm ok with choking, I'm not ok with choking"[/color]
[/b]﻿You are able to turn off/on dialogue by toggling the three options given:[b] "All Dialogue, No Jealousy Dialogue, No Dialogue"[/b]
You are able to turn off/no mail by toggling the three options given: [b]"Mail, No Mail"[/b]
[i]  ﻿Toggling this one off will **not** get rid of the mail needed for his events. You'll have to turn off events to get rid of that mail.[/i]
                    ﻿ 


[url=https://ibb.co/qW2rtsC][/url][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/bRzngRJy/event-triggers-better.png[/img][/url]

[font=Trebuchet MS]The triggers & console commands for the rewritten vanilla events are the same as base game! [/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#e06666][size=4]THE NEW EVENT TRIGGERS ARE AS FOLLOWS:[/size][/color]
[/b]
[u]1 Heart Event[/u]: Enter town on a non-winter, sunny day from 8am to 3pm[/font]
[list]
[*][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b]debug ebi ADAlexIntro[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][color=#ea9999][font=Trebuchet MS][i][b]**Watch Alex's VANILLA 2 heart event here, it's been rewritten** [/b][/i][/font][/color]
[font=Trebuchet MS]
[u]3 Heart Event[/u]: You must've seen his vanilla 2 heart event first. Enter the bathhouse POOL between 3pm and 8pm[/font]
[list]
[*][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b]debug ebi ADAlexHillBilly[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][b][font=Trebuchet MS][u]3 Heart Event, Part 2[/u]: After seeing the previous event, exit the mines between 8pm and 12am[/font][/b]
[list]
[*][size=1][b][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: debug ebi ADAlexSavingPvtFarmer[/font][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][i][b][color=#ea9999][font=Trebuchet MS]**Watch Alex's VANILLA 4 and 5 heart events here, they've been rewritten**[/font][/color][/b][/i]
[font=Trebuchet MS]
[u]**NEW** 6 Heart Event[/u]: You must've seen AD Sebastian's shotgun kiss event first, enter the mountain at any time. **Works best if you actually kiss Sebastian in the event[/font]
[list]
[*][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b]debug ebi ADAlexJealousOverSeb[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][i][color=#ea9999][font=Trebuchet MS][b]**Watch Alex's VANILLA 6 heart event here, it's been rewritten.**[/b][/font][/color][/i]
[font=Trebuchet MS]
[u]7 Heart Event[/u]: You must've seen the 3 heart event first. Enter Pierre's from 5pm to 8pm.[/font]
[list]
[*][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b]debug ebi ADAlexStalker[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][i][b][color=#ea9999][font=Trebuchet MS]**Watch Alex's VANILLA 8 heart event here, it's been rewritten.**[/font][/color][/b][/i]


[size=4][u][b][font=Trebuchet MS]There are two routes you can choose for the 9 heart event. [/font][/b][/u][/size]
[font=Trebuchet MS]
[u]9 Heart Event ([b]You're pursuing him AND/OR you don't want any choking[/b])[/u]: You will receive a locket in Alex's new 8 heart event. You must have this item on you when you go into the bathhouse POOL between 6pm and 12am. You CANNOT have seen the other 9 heart event. [/font]
[list]
[*][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands: [b]debug ebi ADAlexNecklaceKiss[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u]9 Heart Event (You might not want to pursue him OR you're ok with choking)[/u]. This event will not be triggerable if you have "I'm not ok with choking" enabled in your config menu. [/b]You must NOT have Alex's locket in your inventory when you enter the bathhouse POOL between 6pm and 12am. [/font]
[list]
[*][size=1][font=Trebuchet MS]Or to trigger this event via console commands:  [b]debug ebi ADAlexNoNecklaceKiss[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][i][b][color=#ea9999]**Watch Alex's VANILLA 10 heart & 14 heart events here, the 10h  has been MAJORLY rewritten with the 14 barely being touched.**[/color][/b][/i][/font]
